title: Outlook: 1-year and 2-year offline email sync options in new Outlook for Windows
summary: Hold: the briefing incorrectly calls the offline switch the only related control, although Microsoft also documents a policy controlling offline attachments. The roadmap facts, licensing model and PowerShell command are supported.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans a choice to save one year of email offline in new Outlook for Windows.
claims.quote: In the new Outlook for Windows, users can choose to save 1 year or 2 years of email on their device for offline access.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans a choice to save two years of email offline in new Outlook for Windows.
claims.quote: In the new Outlook for Windows, users can choose to save 1 year or 2 years of email on their device for offline access.

claims.claim: These options expand existing offline settings.
claims.quote: This expands the existing offline settings and allows users to access more email when they are not connected to the internet.

Microsoft Learn does not yet describe the one-year and two-year offline options.
claims.quote: Searched: "new Outlook" "1 year" "2 years" offline; new Outlook Windows 1 year 2 years offline options default licensing price storage limit. Opened release notes and policy management; results describe existing offline features, not these options.

claims.claim: The May 30, 2025 release, version 20250523006.11, expanded the default offline mail sync window from seven to 30 days.
claims.quote:
## May 30, 2025
*Version 20250523006.11*
Offline Days of email to save expanded to 30 days: The default mail sync window in offline mode has been expanded from seven days to 30 days.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The longer-window capability is user-opt-in: users choose the new values.
claims.quote: users can choose to save 1 year or 2 years of email on their device for offline access

claims.claim: No administrator action to enable the new values is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: new Outlook Windows offline Days of email to save admin policy sync window Set-OwaMailboxPolicy Cloud Policy; "new Outlook" "Days of email to save" policy. Opened policy management and Set-OwaMailboxPolicy; no activation requirement for the new values.

claims.where: controls[0]; summary; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no admin UI or API that sets the number of days of email saved offline in new Outlook.
claims.quote: Searched: "new Outlook" "Days of email to save" policy; "new Outlook" "offline" "sync window" "Graph"; new Outlook Windows offline Days of email to save admin policy sync window Set-OwaMailboxPolicy Cloud Policy. Opened policy management, EAC policy properties, and cmdlet reference.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; rendered controls table; Governance controls
claims.claim: Exchange admin center > Roles > Outlook web app policies > policy > Access > Manage access > Offline access reaches the documented offline-access section.
claims.quote: In the EAC, go to Roles > Outlook web app policies. ... In the Details flyout that opens ... Access: Select Manage access. In the Edit access flyout ... File access ... Offline access
claims.fix: Use the fuller path 'Roles > Outlook web app policies > policy > Details > Access > Manage access > Edit access > Offline access'. Keep the route described as reaching the Offline access section; the cited page does not name an individual switch within that section.

claims.claim: Set-OwaMailboxPolicy -Identity <policy name> -OfflineEnabledWin $false disables new Outlook offline capabilities for the specified policy.
claims.quote: The Identity parameter specifies the Outlook on the web mailbox policy that you want to modify. ... Name ... $false: Users can't manage offline capabilities in Outlook. No items are saved to the user's device. Previously save items are deleted.

claims.claim: OfflineEnabledWin allows or blocks offline use of new Outlook for Windows.
claims.quote: The OfflineEnabledWin parameter on the Set-OwaMailboxPolicy cmdlet allows or blocks the new Outlook for Windows from being used offline.

claims.claim: OfflineEnabledWin does not set the number of days or selectively block longer windows while leaving offline mode on.
claims.quote: The OfflineEnabledWin parameter specifies whether offline capabilities are available ... $true: Users can manage offline capabilities in Outlook. ... $false: Users can't manage offline capabilities in Outlook. No items are saved to the user's device.

claims.claim: The existing offline switch is the only related control.
claims.quote: The AttachmentsOfflineEnabledWin parameter specifies whether file attachments are available for offline use in Outlook (formerly known as the new Outlook for Windows). This parameter only applies when offline capabilities are enabled in Outlook.
claims.fix: Replace 'the existing offline switch is the only related control (see the controls table)' with 'the existing OfflineEnabledWin switch allows or blocks offline use altogether (see the controls table)'. Do not add another control row.

claims.claim: The option uses the included licensing model of the Outlook desktop product.
claims.quote: To use the Outlook for Windows desktop app (either the classic or new version) with a Microsoft 365 organizational email address, you need to purchase a plan that includes the desktop versions of the Microsoft 365 apps.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Microsoft's licensing page requires a plan including desktop Microsoft 365 apps to use classic or new Outlook for Windows with a Microsoft 365 organisational address.
claims.quote: To use the Outlook for Windows desktop app (either the classic or new version) with a Microsoft 365 organizational email address, you need to purchase a plan that includes the desktop versions of the Microsoft 365 apps.

claims.claim: No licensing requirement specific to the new offline-window options is published.
claims.quote: Searched: new Outlook offline 1 year 2 years email sync window license price meter account storage requirements. Opened Understand licensing in new Outlook for Windows and release notes; neither states an option-specific licence.

claims.claim: The roadmap record names no licence for the option.
claims.quote: The new options are available under Settings > General > Offline > Days of email to save, giving users greater flexibility based on their storage and offline needs.

claims.claim: No price specific to the new offline-window options is published.
claims.quote: Searched: new Outlook offline 1 year 2 years email sync window license price meter account storage requirements; new Outlook Windows 1 year 2 years offline options default licensing price storage limit. Opened licensing options and release notes; no option-specific price.

claims.claim: No meter specific to the new offline-window options is published.
claims.quote: Searched: new Outlook offline 1 year 2 years email sync window license price meter account storage requirements. Opened licensing options and release notes; no offline-window meter is named.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated that arrival of the new options changes the default window value.
claims.quote: Searched: new Outlook Windows 1 year 2 years offline options default licensing price storage limit; "new Outlook" "1 year" "2 years" offline. Read the roadmap and release notes; the 30-day default is historical, with no default change attributed to this item.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated that the new options change existing users' selected values.
claims.quote: Searched: "new Outlook" "1 year" "2 years" offline; new Outlook Windows 1 year 2 years offline options default licensing price storage limit. Read the roadmap and release notes; neither announces migration of existing selected values.

claims.claim: Eligibility and account-type exclusions specific to the longer offline options are not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: new Outlook offline 1 year 2 years email sync window license price meter account storage requirements. Read roadmap, licensing options and release notes; product licensing is documented, but no eligibility or exclusions specific to these longer options.

claims.claim: Storage requirements and storage or mailbox-size limits specific to the longer windows are not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: new Outlook Windows 1 year 2 years offline options default licensing price storage limit; new Outlook offline 1 year 2 years email sync window license price meter account storage requirements. Read roadmap and release notes; returned file-size limits concern classic Outlook.

claims.claim: The Learn licensing page says Microsoft 365 accounts with a Frontline licence cannot be added to new Outlook.
claims.quote: Can Microsoft 365 accounts with a Frontline license be added to new Outlook? No. ... Users with these licenses are required to use the web and mobile versions of Outlook and Microsoft 365 apps.

claims.claim: Microsoft's classic Outlook guidance warns that applying a higher sync-window value to hundreds or more clients can adversely affect network bandwidth.
claims.quote: Applying a higher value to hundreds or more clients at the same time could adversely affect available network bandwidth.
